## Project completion — review submission

## Completion assessment — Plan NN

Evidence: [real integrated test or review receipt](https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/NUMBER)
Completion: Yes — State exactly which project acceptance criteria were demonstrated.
Implementation PRs: https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/NUMBER (all relevant PRs; or None — non-code work)
Integrated candidate: Full SHA(s)/exact versioned result URL (or None — non-code work)
Unproven: Name remaining untested/failing scenarios and unsupported cases, or None within the stated scope.
Gap F-XXX: Unchanged — Replace with a justified disposition for **each actual linked gap**.

### Implementation and integration

- **Project:** Link the canonical Astrid-dev `plan.md`.
- **Product PRs:** Link every Runtime, Agent, App or other PR; include final merge/destination status and dependencies.
- **Qualified candidate:** Exact integrated repository SHAs / installed tuple, or explain why no product code applies.
- **Checks and observation:** Focused tests, actual results, important negative cases and evidence links.
- **Limits and risks:** What remains unproven, failed or deferred; migration/rollback/data risk as appropriate.

### Review requested

Independent review of actual integrated behavior and evidence. The completion PR is the **evidence-pack summary**, not a new evidence database. Do not claim that separately green product PRs prove the combined result.

[Project completion process](../../docs/contribution-workflow.md#submit-a-completed-project).
